full_judgment: 3. The property involved in this case, a house property bearing holding No. 2/17, Nurjahan Road, Block-D, within Mohammadpur Housing Estate, Dhaka, originally belonged to one Nazir Ahmed. The petitioner contracted to purchase the said property from said Nazir Ahmed and entered into an agreement on 12.3.74 and paid Tk. 10,000.00 as advance out of total consideration of Tk. 25,000.00 and in pursuance of the said agreement got possession of the said property. As Nazir Ahmed did not execute the sale deed, the petitioner filed Title Suit No. 160 of 1982 on 6.3.82 and obtained an ex parte decree on 14.12.83 for specific performance of the said contract against Nazir Ahmed. The petitioner put the decree in execution and ultimately the executing court registered the sale deed in favour of the petitioner on 19.1.85. The said house property was included in the list of the abandoned properties as published in the Bangladesh Gazette, Extraordinary dated 23.9.86 and against thereof the aforesaid case was filed under section 7 of the Ordinance No. 54 of 1985 in the Court of Settlement. Ultimately, the case was dismissed for default by the Court of Settlement on 11.2.88.
